mechanics.rewardWindowQuote: Incentives/weights are calculated from 7 day sum of compute, so be patient when you start mining. We want high quality, stable miners in it for the long haul!
mechanics.bountyQuote: Incentives are based on total compute time (including bounties given from being first to provide inference on code app).

gpuVariety.quote: You should probably run a wide variety of GPUs, from very cheap (a10, a5000, t4, etc.) to very powerful (8x h100 nodes).

optimizationTargets: Maximize total compute time — THE reward metric (validator weights on the 7-day sum)
Optimize cold-start times — pre-empted/new apps must spin up fast to win chutes
Tune gepetto.py — chute selection, scaling and bounty claiming is 'the main thing to optimize as a miner'
Run a GPU variety — cheap cards (a10/t4/a5000) through 8x-H100-class nodes earn different chute mixes
Cost efficiency — gepetto weighs hourly server cost when choosing where to deploy chutes

operations.title: One UID only — scale by adding capacity
operations.detail: Registering multiple UIDs splits and competes with your own compute time. Add GPU capacity to the single miner instead.
operations.quote: Never register more than one UID, since it will just reduce your total compute time and you'll compete with yourself pointlessly.

operations.title: TEE-exclusive workers (Intel TDX)
operations.detail: Every GPU worker runs inside an Intel TDX confidential VM provisioned by sek8s host-tools; add-node rejects non-TEE nodes and the legacy GraVal path is blocked. Attestation service exposes NodePort 30443.

operations.title: Control plane is a separate non-GPU server
operations.detail: Miner API, gepetto, postgres, redis, registry proxy and monitoring run on a non-GPU server provisioned by ansible (4c/32GB minimum guidance). Worker nodes are TDX VMs — they have no SSH access.

operations.title: Kubernetes networking is public
operations.detail: NodePorts for k8s services are public (30000-32767); attestation 30443 and the miner agent 32000 must be reachable. RAM ≥ VRAM per GPU on workers.
